ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What would happen to mice if snakes increased?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a food web, labeled with hawk, snake, mouse, rabbit, wildflowers, grass. mouse is located at the lower right of the figure, and snake is located above it and slightly to the right; the arrow from mouse to snake indicates that the snake feeds on the mouse, and the snake depends on the mouse as food. Then reason: the question asks what change will happen to the mouse if snakes increase. The snake is the predator of the mouse, and an increase in the number of snakes will eat more mice, so the number of mice will decrease.
